function: The only learned element is k-medoids clustering with Silhouette analysis, which groups users per subcarrier (scheduling-type resource allocation); power allocation is classical water-filling; excluded as above_phy (pp. 4-6).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. p. 4: "A subcarrier is assigned to an optimum number of users such that the interference between the users is minimized using a machine learning (ML) strategy"; p. 5: "A k-medoids-based clustering approach is employed to group Ns,j users, allocated to a subcarrier s"; Algorithm 1 (p. 6) uses clustering for subcarrier allocation and iterative water-filling for power (pp. 5-6). Alternative reading: if clustering is not counted as learned (p. 5: "without any training on a data set"), the code is no_learning. ISAC appears only in title, abstract, introduction and conclusion; Section III (pp. 3-4) models uplink PD-NOMA with ambient backscatter tags and N single-antenna users, with no sensing function or metric, so no area of the seven fits. Table I, Algorithm 1 and Fig. 2 were read from PDF pages 3 and 6.
